title: Treasury Action Not a Fed Game Changer for September, Says Evercore’s Guha
summary: Krishna Guha, vice chair and head of central bank strategy at Evercore ISI, says the US Treasury Department’s move to increase its planned purchases of outstanding 10-year to 30-year debt “certainly complicates things” for Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh, but won’t impact the central bank’s September decision on interest rates. (Source: Bloomberg)
